name: eos-face
description: Expose EOS capabilities through FACE surface, map Work actions to UI affordances, and preserve EOS continuity principles.
triggers: add UI affordance for Work action
trigger: add UI affordance for Work action

inputs: capability_list: array - List of capabilities to expose
outputs: ui_affordance_mapping: object - Work action to UI mapping

preconditions: All capabilities to expose are registered in EOS capability registry

risks: Creating competing Work state or mutation authority
Bypassing policy checks in surface layer
Modifying EOS core state for surface requirements
Implementing standalone workflow engine in FACE
risk_assessment.impact: High - FACE is primary user surface, incorrect implementation breaks work continuity
risk_assessment.mitigation: Mandatory verification with eos-face-verification before production, never create new mutation authority

authority_boundaries: Can only generate surface configurations and mappings, cannot modify backend or core state
Can only write surface files to .eos-state/face/
Cannot modify locked directories: packages/eos-core/foundations/, src/eos/semantics/
Must preserve canonical EOS state ownership - Fabric remains authoritative
